Single Replication from the Simulation Study

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Source: vignettes/sim-rep.Rmd
sim-rep.Rmd
library(OpenMx)
library(fitDTVARMxID)
library(metaVAR)
library(manMetaVAR)

Data Generation 

taskid <- 1
seed <- 42
set.seed(seed)
data <- GenData(taskid = taskid)
plot(data)

summary(data)
#>        id            time             y1                y2         
#>  Min.   : 1.0   Min.   : 0.00   Min.   :-3.1668   Min.   :-4.3151  
#>  1st Qu.:13.0   1st Qu.:24.75   1st Qu.:-0.1779   1st Qu.:-1.1083  
#>  Median :25.5   Median :49.50   Median : 0.5447   Median :-0.3993  
#>  Mean   :25.5   Mean   :49.50   Mean   : 0.5734   Mean   :-0.4059  
#>  3rd Qu.:38.0   3rd Qu.:74.25   3rd Qu.: 1.2960   3rd Qu.: 0.2786  
#>  Max.   :50.0   Max.   :99.00   Max.   : 5.8231   Max.   : 3.9639

MetaVAR 

dtvar <- FitDTVAR(data)
summary(dtvar, means = TRUE)

#> fitDTVARMxID::FitDTVARMxID(data = data$data, observed = paste0("y",

summary(mlvar)

Mplus 

mplus <- FitMplus(data)
summary(mplus)
#> Error in utils::read.table(text = object$output$posterior): no lines available in input

Posterior Distributions
